name: money-desk
description: Read-only access to your Money Desk spending data, stored on this computer.
long_description: Lets Claude answer questions about your spending, income, investments, subscriptions and recurring payments using the transactions you imported into Money Desk. It reads the Money Desk data file on this computer and never changes it. It makes no network connections. UPI IDs and reference numbers are not included.

tools.name: get_summary
tools.description: Spent, income, invested and saved for a period, by month and by category

tools.name: list_transactions
tools.description: Individual transactions with filters for dates, account, category, text and amount

tools.name: spending_breakdown
tools.description: Spending grouped by category, merchant, account or month

tools.name: find_recurring_payments
tools.description: Rent, SIPs, bills and subscriptions that repeat each month

tools.name: get_accounts_and_categories
tools.description: Imported accounts and date coverage, categories and saved rules

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: Your own list of accounts, cards, subscriptions, mandates, SIPs, insurance and loans

data_file.title: Money Desk data file
data_file.description: Leave empty to use Documents\money-desk\money-desk\data\money-desk.json. Otherwise pick money-desk.json inside your Money Desk folder's data folder.
